name: EdgeSight
description: Local privacy filtering and browser-local OCR/WASM perception over sanitized screenshot pixels. No remote model or planner.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'none'; connect-src 'self' data:; worker-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self'
